segments.title: 第30章 暴露
segments.content:
Chapter 30: Exposed

In truth, Li Luo hadn't heard what the two girls were talking about at all.

The reason he was stunned on the spot was simply that he recognized the girl beside Ying Chanxi.

Of course, it was from his past life.

Back then, he had just graduated from university and, after getting his chef's certificate, was arranged by his parents to work in the back kitchen of a hotel.

Later, he quit to write novels, and a senior in web fiction helped him out a great deal.

Yes... that person was Xu Youyu.

At the very beginning, Li Luo had always thought the other person was a man.

Even though readers often called this author "Sister Go-to-bed-early," there were also nicknames like "Cuttlefish-chan." Li Luo naturally didn't think much of it, assuming it was just an affectionate term from the readers.

The person behind "Go-to-bed-early-or-you-won't-grow-taller" had never directly addressed their own gender.

When Li Luo first entered the industry writing urban entertainment novels, it was with the guidance of "Go-to-bed-early-or-you-won't-grow-taller" that he was able to successfully cross the contract threshold.

Later, when Li Luo achieved some success, he reported the good news to his mentor "Go-to-bed-early." As they talked more, they discovered they were both from Yuhang City.

So they arranged to meet up offline, and only then did Li Luo realize that "Go-to-bed-early-or-you-won't-grow-taller" was actually a woman, and a very beautiful one at that.

Afterward, the two of them often met up for meals.

Because they were both entertainment genre authors, they would also watch all sorts of movies together, share TV series and song playlists, and gossip about all kinds of news from the entertainment industry, calling it "gathering material" for the sake of appearances.

Unfortunately, Li Luo couldn't endure the hardship of churning out words. After a few consecutive flops, he ran off to shoot short dramas.

In that same year, "Go-to-bed-early-or-you-won't-grow-taller's" new book performed exceptionally well, earning her the title of one of the year's Twelve Heavenly Kings. The following year, she secured a Great God contract, soaring to the top in a single leap.

Upon hearing that Li Luo had gone to shoot short dramas, Xu Youyu had enthusiastically come to join in the fun, investing a sum of money in his short drama productions.

In the end, Li Luo messed up and lost a lot of money.

Although Xu Youyu didn't mind, Li Luo still felt very embarrassed. After that, he retreated behind the scenes to focus on writing scripts for short dramas, paying Xu Youyu back a little each month whenever he earned some money.

But because of this, the two of them gradually drifted apart, and eventually, they barely kept in touch.

It wasn't until Lin Xiuhong later fell gravely ill that Li Luo, unable to scrape together any more money, had to swallow his pride and find Xu Youyu, asking if he could borrow some.

Xu Youyu asked him how much he needed.

Li Luo said fifty thousand, or thirty thousand would be fine too.

Without another word, Xu Youyu transferred eighty thousand to him.

He hadn't even managed to pay back this sum before he was reborn.

He never thought that after being reborn, they would meet in such a way...

Li Luo could never have imagined that Xu Youyu was a tenant at his third granduncle's house back in high school.

The six degrees of separation theory was truly no joke.

"Didn't we say we were going to buy groceries? Let's go."

Xu Youyu was a very cheerful and sunny girl. Even though she was the most of a stranger among the three people present, she wasn't the least bit timid.

"I'm Xu Youyu. I know both of you now, Xixi just told me about you."

"Go... Senior Xu, hello." Li Luo came back to his senses, nearly letting it slip. He then nodded and said, "Let's go buy groceries."

"I have a question," Zhao Rongjun couldn't help but ask in a small voice. "When we get back with the groceries, who's going to cook? Does Ying Chanxi know how?"

"Hmm?" Ying Chanxi blinked and shook her head repeatedly. "I don't. Li Luo does."

"Huh?" Zhao Rongjun's face was filled with shock. He turned to look at Li Luo, then subconsciously took half a step back. "You can cook?"

"What's with that suspicious look?" Li Luo said, displeased. "Are you my brother or not?"

"What does this have to do with being brothers?" Zhao Rongjun took another half step back. "You know what, I think I'll just go back to my grandpa's place for dinner."

"Where do you think you're going?!" Li Luo grabbed him by the neck, his eyebrows raised. "You haven't tasted my cooking yet, have you? Tonight, I'll open your eyes. It'll be so delicious you'll be calling me daddy."

The moment he said that, before Zhao Rongjun could even react, Ying Chanxi had already kicked Li Luo.

"Hey, what did you kick me for?"

"You know perfectly well."

...

Returning from the market with their hands full, the group went back to Bihai Lanting.

Li Luo walked into the kitchen to prepare dinner.

The other three sat on the living room sofa to chat.

Of course, it was basically Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu doing the talking.

The moment Zhao Rongjun found himself in an environment with only girls around, he immediately became mute. He just sat on the sofa looking at his phone, but in reality, he was just opening QQ, closing it, then opening it again, with no idea what he was actually looking at.

"You guys still have classes tomorrow, right?" Xu Youyu sat cross-legged on the sofa, her hands resting on her ankles, and said to the two, "I remember the early summer session lasts four weeks every year, and then it's the school's military training."

"Right." Ying Chanxi nodded, her legs held neatly together, her posture very prim. "We still have to go to class tomorrow, and then it's official school registration."

"The military training after registration is actually pretty interesting," Xu Youyu said with a grin. "For the first few days, you'll be at school getting used to the intensity, and for the last few days, they'll take you to a nearby military base to train. There are a lot of fun activities."

"We'll go to a military base?" Ying Chanxi was a little surprised. "Will it be very tiring?"

"It's military training, so it's always tiring," Xu Youyu said, patting her own face. "The most important thing is sun protection. Remember to prepare sunscreen in advance."

"Oh, right." After chatting about military training, Xu Youyu suddenly remembered something, took out her phone, and asked the two, "What are your QQ numbers? I'll add you."

As she spoke, Xu Youyu had already opened the QQ interface on her phone.

Glancing at the friend request page, she noticed that "Rekindle" still hadn't accepted her friend request. Xu Youyu couldn't help but let out a "tsk."

Could this guy be looking down on her, directly ignoring her friend request?

Thinking this, Xu Youyu tapped into the "add friend" page and looked at Ying Chanxi and Zhao Rongjun beside her.

So the two of them recited their QQ numbers.

After adding them, Ying Chanxi said, "I'll just send Li Luo's QQ number to you."

As she spoke, she had already copied and pasted the number and sent it directly to Xu Youyu.

Xu Youyu glanced at it. As she was copying it, she felt that the number looked a bit familiar.

But when she searched for it...

"Is something wrong?" Ying Chanxi asked with concern when she saw her strange expression.

"It's nothing." Xu Youyu silently put her phone away. From the corner of her eye, she cast a light glance at the busy Li Luo in the kitchen and chuckled. "Xixi, is Li Luo's Chinese grade pretty good?"

"It's pretty good, I think." Ying Chanxi nodded. "He got 110 on the high school entrance exam this time, third in the whole school, and his essay was a perfect score."

"A perfect score on his essay?" Xu Youyu raised an eyebrow, slightly surprised, but then felt it was reasonable and immediately accepted this fact. "That's quite impressive."

"But he's definitely not as impressive as you, Senior Xu." Ying Chanxi shook her head with a smile. "Senior, you've won so many essay competition awards. All Li Luo has to show is one perfect-score essay."

"Mm..." Xu Youyu managed a nod.

Was she more impressive than Li Luo?

But Li Luo's "I'm Really Not a Star" was ranked fifth on the new book chart this period, and everyone ahead of him was either a Great God or an old LV5 author.

Meanwhile, she was ranked 31st, thoroughly suppressed...

To think that Rekindle was actually someone her own age!

And a junior, at that!

Xu Youyu secretly gritted her teeth and glanced again at the friend request on her phone.

Li Luo wasn't on it.

There was only a "Rekindle," still in the "friend request not accepted" stage.
